d.s: A flexible, cement-based tile adhesive ideal for large format and rectified edge tiles.
a: Non-vertical slump for easy wall tiling
Use for thick or thin bed tiling
Extended open time for tiling large areas
White formulation ideal for light coloured tiles and stone
us: Most common substrates; building boards including compressed and fibre cement sheet, fully cured concrete, screed (cured for 7 days), rendered brickwork and blockwork, Davco waterproofing membranes and acoustic underlays.
Ideal for large format and rectified (square) edge tiles, porcelain, ceramic, mosaic and marble tiles.

Suitable for interior and exterior applications. Commercial and domestic walls and floors including high foot traffic locations, bathrooms, showers, kitchens, laundries, living rooms, balconies and patios.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: 20kg bag of Davco® Powder Mastic covers approximately 7 m2 (based on a 10mm notch trowel)

mix_ratio.label: Mixing ratio
mix_ratio.text: 5-6 Litres of clean cool potable water per 20kg

cure_times.label: Light foot traffic
cure_times.text: 24 hours Prior to grouting 24 hours Return to dry are service 24 hours Return to wet area service 7 days All measurements are taken at 22ºC and 50% relative humidity

hazard_statements.statement: May cause an allergic skin reaction.
hazard_statements.text: H317 May cause an allergic skin reaction.

hazard_statements.statement: May cause damage to organs through prolonged or repeated exposure.
hazard_statements.text: H373 May cause damage to organs through prolonged or repeated exposure.

precautionary_statements.statement: Do not breathe dust.
precautionary_statements.text: P260 Do not breathe dust.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wash skin thoroughly after handling.
precautionary_statements.text: P264 Wash skin thoroughly after handling.

precautionary_statements.statement: Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.
precautionary_statements.text: P272 Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.
precautionary_statements.text: P280 Wear protective gloves/ eye protection/ face protection.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.
precautionary_statements.text: P302 + P352 IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.
precautionary_statements.text: P305 + P351 + P338 + P310 IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing. Immediately call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.

precautionary_statements.statement: Get medical advice/ attention if you feel unwell.
precautionary_statements.text: P314 Get medical advice/ attention if you feel unwell.

precautionary_statements.statement: If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.
precautionary_statements.text: P333 + P313 If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.

precautionary_statements.statement: Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.
precautionary_statements.text: P362 + P364 Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.

precautionary_statements.statement: Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.
precautionary_statements.text: P501 Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Further information on storage stability
storage.text: Keep in a dry place. No decomposition if stored and applied as directed.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Avoid dust formation. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid formation of respirable particles. Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator. particulate filter P

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber, PVC, cotton gloves

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Avoid dust formation. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.
